entities.name: Our Lady of Lourdes Cathedral, Florencia

entities.summary: Our Lady of Lourdes Cathedral, also called Florencia Cathedral, is a Catholic cathedral in the municipality of Florencia, in Colombia. It is the principal church of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Florencia.
